IMAGINE Database Listing Version Reconciliation
===============================================

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


Primary version (currently used in DataQC pipeline)

```{r}
old_img = read.csv('input/current/IMAGINE_StoolSpecimenCollectionIDListing_20251009_reformatted.csv',
                   strip.white = TRUE)
head(old_img)
```

The very latest version (March 2026)

```{r}
new_img = read.csv('input/current/IMAGINE_StoolSpecimenCollectionIDListing_20260326.csv',
                   strip.white = TRUE)
head(new_img)
```

If they are identical this is trivial:

```{r}
all.equal(new_img, old_img)

old_img$Participant.ID[!(old_img$Participant.ID %in% new_img$Participant.ID)]
filter(old_img, !(Participant.ID %in% new_img$Participant.ID))
```
